name: Deltadromeus
isnote: Controversial theropod; placed in Noasauridae by Hendrickx et al. 2024 but other analyses recover it elsewhere in Ceratosauria or in Megaraptora.
sum: Controversial mid-Cretaceous theropod from Morocco described in 1996 from an incomplete postcranial skeleton.
holotype: Not given in the sources used.
material: An incomplete postcranial skeleton (holotype SGM Din-2, according to the Commons file title).
biology: Not given in the sources used.
author: Sereno et al. 1996
